text:
paul-nguyen: hey team, paul here starting today in CS. couple blockers: my HubSpot inbox forwarding isn't showing customer emails, can't find canned replies, and need the playbook for trial-to-paid flows. who should i bug?

zara-cs-lead: welcome Paul! @mike-ops for HubSpot/inbox mapping, @tori-onboarding for playbooks and canned replies. i'll add you to the shadow rota and the trial-to-paid playbook in Notion.

mike-ops: hey Paul  send me the email you used and i'll check the inbox forwarding rules. Also confirm if you're on the shared CS inbox or personal agent inbox.

paul-nguyen: paul.nguyen@redwood.ai. looks like i'm on shared inbox but emails aren't routing to my HubSpot queue.

mike-ops: created ticket HSP-7210 for routing. Access-bot: HSP-7210 created and assigned to mike-ops. ETA ~1.5 hours. Meanwhile check Gmail filters (we have a common filter that forwards to hubspot@redwood.ai).

tori-onboarding: I'll DM you the Notion link and drop the short trial -> paid playbook under "Quick Start". canned replies are in Drive > CS > Templates. i'll add the most common ones into a Notion checklist too.

paul-nguyen: got the Notion invite, but the trial playbook PDF link 404s.

zara-cs-lead: thanks for flagging. @tori-onboarding i'll need that PDF fixed for the onboarding bundle.

tori-onboarding: fixed the Drive link and mirrored the PDF into Notion. also added a 10-min Loom that walks through the trial qualification rubric.

mike-ops: routing fixed. you should now see inbound customer emails in HubSpot under the "CS Shared" queue. If you still don't, try logging out and back in.

access-bot: HSP-7210 status: resolved.

paul-nguyen: can confirm emails are arriving now. quick question: what's our recommended subject line format when escalating to Sales?

zara-cs-lead: use: "[Escalation] <Customer> - <short reason>" and tag the contact with "escalate-to-sales" in HubSpot. also add a 1-2 sentence summary in the activity.

paul-nguyen: last one  where do we store competitor objection one-pagers? want to have those handy.

tori-onboarding: Drive > Sales & CS > Collateral > Competitive > One-Pagers. i'll add a pinned shortcut in the Notion playbook.

zara-cs-lead: welcome again Paul. schedule for today: 1) import sample contacts, 2) make a test outbound via Aircall, 3) watch the 5 onboarding clips in Gong, 4) shadow two live calls. ping here if anything stalls.

paul-nguyen: thanks everyone! i'll follow up here if anything else pops up. :smile:
